question: Como configuro o Rashin pela primeira vez?

expect.ideal: Abra Ryoku Settings com Super+vírgula, entre em Rashin e use Set up Hermes agent. O assistente instala ou mantém o Hermes, faz o onboarding do provedor/modelo, conecta o vault e ativa o daemon; no terminal, o equivalente é `ryoku-rashin setup`, sem sudo. (source: docs/rashin.mdx)

question: Where should my lasting config changes go?

expect.ideal: Use Ryoku Settings for covered options. For hand edits, use the update-safe files such as `~/.config/hypr/user.lua`, `~/.config/niri/user.kdl`, or a mirrored file under `~/.config/ryoku/user_edits/`; do not edit Ryoku-shipped files in place. (source: docs/customize.mdx)

question: ¿Dónde preparo la GPU para passthrough?

expect.ideal: Abre Ryoku Settings > Graphics & Power y elige el modo Passthrough. Ese modo fija la GPU integrada para el escritorio y deja libre la GPU discreta para la máquina virtual; el cambio de GPU se aplica al volver a iniciar sesión. La página no sustituye la configuración de IOMMU, VFIO ni de la VM. (source: docs/hardware.mdx)

question: What is Ryoku Doctor actually for?

expect.ideal: `ryoku doctor` checks and reconciles stateful drift that packages and config cannot express. Start with `ryoku doctor --check` for a no-change preview; use `ryoku doctor --report` when you need a shareable diagnostic report. (source: docs/cli.md)

question: Where do display changes survive updates?

expect.ideal: Use Ryoku Settings > Displays for normal layouts; its generated per-machine monitor file is not reset by `ryoku update`. For a forced mode or layout the page cannot express, put the override in `monitors_user.lua` on Hyprland or `monitors_user.kdl` on niri, which loads last and survives updates. (source: docs/customize.mdx)

question: How can I place another desktop widget?

expect.ideal: Right-click bare wallpaper, choose Edit desktop, then open Widgets in the Stage Editor. Add the widget, drag or resize its frame, and open Settings for its own controls; Super+Shift+D opens the Widgets catalogue directly. Placement is stored per display. (source: docs/stage.md)

question: Which setting changes the launcher's typeface?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > General > Region & fonts and change System font; that desktop-wide preference is used by the shell, including the launcher. Terminal font and interface scale are separate controls on the same page. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/GlobalPage.js)

question: What font family does Ryoku use?

expect.ideal: Ryoku's defaults are Fraunces for display headlines, Space Grotesk for UI, JetBrains Mono Nerd Font for code and labels, and Noto as the fallback. The user-facing system font is changed in Ryoku Settings > General. (source: docs/theming.mdx)

question: How do I join the testing channel?

expect.ideal: Run `ryoku track unstable` to follow new development; later `ryoku update` continues on that source lane. Return to signed release packages with `ryoku track stable`. Switching does not require reinstalling an ISO. (source: stable docs/cli.md and ryoku/cli/main.go)

question: Can I hide a window without closing it?

expect.ideal: Press Super+H to tuck the focused window into the scratchpad. Super+Alt+H shows or hides the scratchpad; this is Ryoku's hide/minimize-style workflow and does not close the app. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: Where do I replace the browser shortcut target?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Keybinds and change the Browser role. Super+B and other browser actions use whichever app that role points to. (source: docs/apps.mdx)

question: What's Ryotunes meant to do?

expect.ideal: Ryotunes is Ryoku's music app. Open or focus it with Super+J; its playback is exposed through the normal media keys and MPRIS-aware desktop widgets, and it updates from its own releases. (source: docs/apps.mdx)

question: Will an update erase hypr/user.lua?

expect.ideal: No. `~/.config/hypr/user.lua` is the Hyprland user override, loads last, and is seeded once rather than overwritten by materialize or updates. Shipped base files are the ones that get re-laid. (source: docs/customize.mdx)

question: What job does Ryoport handle?

expect.ideal: Ryoport is Ryoku's dashboard for virtual machines, SSH hosts, and serial consoles. Super+Shift+V brings its VM window to the current workspace. (source: docs/apps.mdx)

question: What's the supported way to lock now?

expect.ideal: Press Super+L to lock the screen. That shared binding works on the supported window managers and uses Ryoku's configured lock surface. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: Onde vejo todos os atalhos atuais?

expect.ideal: Pressione Super+K para abrir o Kit, que mostra os atalhos efetivos da máquina na aba Keys e também reúne Commands, Phone, Dev tools e Typing test. O mesmo atalho fecha a tela. (source: docs/compositors.md)

question: What counts as a Ryoku plugin?

expect.ideal: A Ryoku shell plugin is an installable widget or surface with a validated manifest, placed through Ryostore or `ryoku plugin add`. Installed plugins are managed on Ryoku Settings > Add-ons; they run with your user permissions, so install only trusted code. (source: docs/cli.md)

question: How do I open the workspace overview?

expect.ideal: Press Super+Tab for the workspace overview. It shows live previews and lets you drag windows between workspaces; Super+Alt+Tab steps through overview blocks by desktop. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: What's Ryoku's equivalent of Alt+F4?

expect.ideal: Press Super+Q to close the focused window. That is the normal close action; force-killing a process is a separate troubleshooting step, not the default window shortcut. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: ¿Cómo cambio la aplicación de terminal predeterminada?

expect.ideal: Abre Ryoku Settings > Keybinds y cambia el rol Terminal. Super+Enter abre la aplicación asignada a ese rol, así que no hace falta editar los atajos del compositor. (source: docs/apps.mdx)

question: What should I include in a bug report?

expect.ideal: Include the exact actions, what happened, what you expected, `ryoku status`, a fresh `ryoku doctor --report`, and the relevant log slice. For shell issues, attach the last lines of `~/.local/state/ryoku-shell.log` after a reload; the doctor report is designed not to contain passwords or keys. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Fish won't open these report paths; why?

expect.ideal: Those paths name text files, not commands. Read them with a viewer such as `less ~/.local/state/ryoku/doctor-report.txt` and `less ~/.local/state/ryoku-shell.log`; regenerate the report with `ryoku doctor --report` if needed. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Where did the appearance controls move?

expect.ideal: Wallpaper, palette, theme, and rice controls are in Ryogami rather than a Hub Appearance page. Press Super+W, then Shift+S for the picker's settings and open Theme; window look such as gaps, blur, and borders remains under Ryoku Settings > Window manager. (source: docs/theming.mdx)

question: Is there a separate dock animation switch?

expect.ideal: Open QS Bar Settings > Dock for the dock controls. Current stable exposes show/hide, edge, autohide, and pins, but not a separate dock-animation toggle; desktop motion is controlled by the general Animations setting. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/bar.md)

question: Where are downloaded rices applied now?

expect.ideal: Open the wallpaper picker with Super+W and use its Rices tab. Applying a rice snapshots the current setup first, and the same tab handles import, export, and saved looks. (source: docs/theming.mdx)

question: Where can I select Catppuccin now?

expect.ideal: Press Super+W, then Shift+S, open Theme, set Palette behaviour to Fixed palette, and choose Catppuccin Mocha under Palette > Theme. Switch back to Follow wallpaper when you want wallpaper-derived colors again. (source: docs/theming.mdx)

question: What does Rashin add to the desktop?

expect.ideal: Rashin is Ryoku's local AI agent layer. Open Ryoku Settings > Rashin to set it up and open its dashboard; its on-disk knowledge vault maps the machine for agents. Alt+Space opens quick Ask and Super+Alt+Space opens or focuses the longer Agent/Rashin window. (source: docs/rashin.md)

question: Can adaptive sync run only fullscreen?

expect.ideal: Yes. Open Ryoku Settings > Displays, select the monitor, and set Adaptive sync to Fullscreen only. Use the offered mode rather than editing the generated monitor file. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/DisplaysPage.js)

question: ¿Cómo dejo activa solamente una pantalla?

expect.ideal: Abre Ryoku Settings > Displays para elegir qué salidas quedan activas. Para cambiar rápido, Super+P alterna entre pantalla interna, externa y ambas; los cambios guardados no se borran con una actualización. (source: docs/hardware.mdx)

question: Can Num Lock start enabled every session?

expect.ideal: Yes. Open Ryoku Settings > Input and enable Numlock on at login; it starts each session with the keypad typing digits. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/InputPage.js)

question: How do I clear a Snapper cleanup warning?

expect.ideal: Run `ryoku doctor --check` first. On a btrfs root, Doctor can recreate a missing Snapper root config, fix `/.snapshots` ownership, and enable the cleanup timer; if the root is not btrfs, Ryoku snapshots are unavailable and updates continue without them. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Why did my Hyprland edits vanish again?

expect.ideal: Edits to Ryoku-shipped files are replaced by `ryoku materialize`. Put lasting Hyprland changes in `~/.config/hypr/user.lua` or a mirrored file under `~/.config/ryoku/user_edits/`; `user.lua` loads last and updates do not touch it. (source: docs/customize.mdx)

question: How can I reorder the top-bar items?

expect.ideal: Open QS Bar Settings > Layout and move widgets among the left, center, and right lanes. For scripting, `ryoku-shell bar move <id> --section <lane>` reaches the same daemon-owned layout; do not hand-edit `shell.json`. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/bar.md)

question: Can windows focus when I hover them?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Input, find Focus behavior, and choose Focus under pointer. The same control is available for supported compositors, so no compositor file edit is needed. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/InputPage.js)

question: Why does my display look low-resolution?

expect.ideal: Check Ryoku Settings > Displays. Laptop panels normally expose only their native mode, so use the scale choices for the desired logical desktop size; if Apply rejects a value, choose one of the offered clean-divisor scales. (source: docs/hardware.mdx)

question: Doctor says my Ryoku repository is missing.

expect.ideal: Run `ryoku doctor --check` to preview the package-channel finding, then `ryoku doctor` to let the registered reconciler repair supported channel and keyring drift. Do not copy an unverified repository stanza from chat. (source: docs/cli.md)

question: Will Ryoku overwrite my existing Neovim setup?

expect.ideal: Ryoku's update-safe model leaves your own additions and the app's supported override paths alone. For Neovim, keep personal changes in LazyVim's own override paths rather than modifying a Ryoku-shipped base file; materialize only clobbers files Ryoku ships. (source: docs/customize.mdx)

question: Como inverto a rolagem do touchpad?

expect.ideal: Abra Ryoku Settings > Input e altere Natural scroll na seção do touchpad. A opção faz o conteúdo acompanhar os dois dedos e é aplicada pela configuração do compositor ativo. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/InputPage.js)

question: How do closing and minimizing differ here?

expect.ideal: Super+Q closes the focused window. Ryoku's minimize-like action is Super+H, which tucks it into the scratchpad; Super+Alt+H shows or hides that scratchpad. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: Why did update treat my note as packages?

expect.ideal: Use Update now in Ryoku Settings > Updates, or run exactly `ryoku update`. Do not append explanatory words from a support message to a package-manager command; the shell passes them as package names. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: How can Files always open tiled?

expect.ideal: Enable Advanced in Ryoku Settings, open Window Rules, add a rule matching Nautilus by class or title, and choose the tile action. For a one-off window, Super+A toggles floating back to tiled. (source: ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/WindowRulesPage.js)

question: Where is the wallpaper depth control now?

expect.ideal: Right-click bare wallpaper, choose Edit desktop, then open Depth in the Stage Editor. Choose Plain, Depth, Parallax, or Spatial and press Generate or Update when ready; choosing a mode alone does not start processing. (source: docs/stage.md)

question: Why can't I find Appearance in Settings?

expect.ideal: There is no general Appearance page for wallpaper colors and rices. Open Ryogami with Super+W, then Shift+S for Theme; compositor look such as blur, gaps, and borders is under Ryoku Settings > Window manager. (source: docs/settings.mdx)

question: Where should persistent custom gestures live?

expect.ideal: If the Input page does not cover the gesture, put the compositor-specific override in `~/.config/hypr/user.lua` or `~/.config/niri/user.kdl`. Those files load last and are never touched by updates; generated settings and rebind files are not safe hand-edit targets. (source: docs/customize.mdx)

question: How do I remove the audio-reactive line?

expect.ideal: Press Super+M to toggle the desktop audio visualizer. Super+Alt+M opens the Stage Editor's Visualizer catalogue, where each instance can be moved, resized, rotated, and given its own look and motion; Super+Shift+M changes whether it sits above or behind windows. (source: docs/stage.md)

question: Will Doctor reinstall an app I removed?

expect.ideal: No: optional apps left out or removed are recorded in Ryoku's provisioning state and stay out. Doctor may deliver a newly default app once to a machine that never had it, but it does not put back an app the user removed. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: ¿Dónde encuentro ahora la opción de apagar?

expect.ideal: Pulsa Super+Escape para abrir Quick Settings; ahí están apagar, reiniciar, cerrar sesión y los controles de energía. No hace falta abrir una terminal ni forzar el botón físico. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: How do I restore wallpaper-driven colors?

expect.ideal: Open the wallpaper picker with Super+W, press Shift+S, open Theme, and set Palette behaviour to Follow wallpaper. The next wallpaper change regenerates the matugen palette for the desktop. (source: docs/theming.mdx)

question: Why does the updater show nothing new?

expect.ideal: Check Ryoku Settings > Updates or run the read-only `ryoku status`; it compares the installed desktop with what the active channel offers. No offered revision means there is nothing to install, not that the updater is broken. On the unstable source lane, status also reports the checkout and its channel gate. (source: docs/cli.md)

question: Can Ryogami stop recompressing my images?

expect.ideal: In the wallpaper picker open Settings > Library > Images & recovery and turn off Auto-optimise new images. When enabled, new PNG, JPEG, and GIF files are converted to WebP and the original is kept in Ryogami's trash for a few days. (source: docs/theming.mdx)

question: Can I preview the full desktop from USB?

must_not_mention: it boots a full persistent desktop
expect.ideal: The current ISO is a live installer image: it boots into a small Wayland kiosk running the installer, not a general persistent desktop preview. To try the workflow safely first, boot the ISO in QEMU/KVM, VirtualBox, or VMware. (source: docs/install.mdx)

question: Login leaves only a terminal on black.

expect.ideal: From that terminal, start `Hyprland`. If the compositor starts, refresh the shell with `ryoku reload` and inspect `~/.local/state/ryoku-shell.log`; if only SDDM is failing, its journal is `sudo journalctl -u sddm -n 200`. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: How do I tile a floating window again?

expect.ideal: Focus the window and press Super+A. The binding toggles a window between floating and tiled, so no compositor restart or config edit is needed. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: Where are dock controls after switching bars?

expect.ideal: Dock controls live in QS Bar Settings, not a separate Hub page. Open its Dock route from the bar or run `ryoku-shell bar settings dock`; that panel controls visibility, edge, autohide, and pins. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/bar.md)

question: Must Secure Boot be off for the ISO?

expect.ideal: The Ryoku ISO does not configure Secure Boot automatically, so disable Secure Boot to boot and install from it. If an existing Arch or CachyOS installation already has a working trusted Secure Boot setup, use the in-place converter instead of assuming the ISO will enroll keys. TPM is a separate setting. (source: docs/install.mdx)

question: Why is my 165 Hz NVIDIA monitor missing?

expect.ideal: I'm not sure from the symptom alone; the cause could be the cable, EDID, driver, GPU routing, or compositor state. Please make a #help post with `ryoku doctor --check` output, a fresh doctor report, and the modes shown in Ryoku Settings > Displays so the hardware evidence can be checked. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Why stays my NVIDIA GPU hot after shutdown?

expect.ideal: I'm not sure without the laptop model, firmware state, and shutdown logs; this can be hardware or firmware specific. Please post in #help with `ryoku doctor --check` output and a fresh doctor report rather than applying a generic NVIDIA blacklist. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Why has my internal microphone disappeared?

expect.ideal: I'm not sure from that description alone; the missing device may be firmware, kernel, profile, or audio-routing specific. Please open a #help post with `ryoku doctor --check` output, the hardware model, and the relevant journal/device listing so someone can diagnose it without guessing. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Why does crossing monitors freeze my NVIDIA desktop?

expect.ideal: I'm not sure without the refresh rates, GPU routing, active effects, and logs; several unrelated NVIDIA multi-monitor faults look like this. Please post in #help with `ryoku doctor --check` output, a fresh report, and both display modes. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: Why do Steam downloads swing wildly on Ryoku?

expect.ideal: I'm not sure from the symptom alone; Steam server choice, Wi-Fi, DNS, storage, and driver state can all produce the same graph. Please post in #help with `ryoku doctor --check` output plus whether wired downloads and non-Steam transfers are stable. (source: docs/troubleshoot.mdx)

question: How do I launch apps and learn shortcuts?

expect.ideal: Press Super+Space and type to launch an app. Super+K opens Kit, whose Keys tab lists the effective shortcuts; F1 inside the launcher explains its search prefixes. (source: docs/launcher.md and docs/compositors.md)

question: How can I check whether an update exists?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Updates, or run the read-only `ryoku status`. It shows the installed desktop version, what the active channel offers, pending distribution packages, and snapshot count without changing the machine. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: How do I enlarge windows and reduce gaps?

expect.ideal: Super+D maximizes while keeping the bar and gaps; Super+F toggles true fullscreen. To reduce the gaps themselves, open Ryoku Settings > Window manager and adjust the layout/gap controls. (source: docs/keybindings.mdx)

question: Do I need Arch installed before Ryoku?

expect.ideal: No. Ryoku v1 provides signed Arch and CachyOS ISOs, plus an experimental Void glibc ISO. Existing supported Arch, CachyOS, Void, and mutable Fedora 44/45 systems can use the script installer; Fedora has no ISO. (source: stable README.md and docs/install-without-iso.md)

question: After pacman -Syu, should Ryoku update too?

expect.ideal: Yes, they are separate lanes: `sudo pacman -Syu` updates the Arch/CachyOS base and kernel, while `ryoku update` updates Ryoku's signed packages, re-lays config, runs Doctor, and reloads the shell. `ryoku update --system` can run both lanes under one snapshot pair. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: Como abro o gravador de tela integrado?

expect.ideal: Pressione Super+Shift+S para abrir a barra de captura Ryoshot e escolha Record; depois selecione região, janela ou monitor e inicie. Qualidade, FPS, codec, áudio e cursor ficam em Ryoku Settings > Recording, com gpu-screen-recorder como backend. (source: docs/sidebars.md and docs/ui-ux.md)

question: Should I run recovery after every update?

expect.ideal: No. Use `ryoku update` normally and Doctor or rollback when troubleshooting. `ryoku recovery` is the last resort for a desktop too broken to update; it restores stable and redeploys while overwriting Ryoku configs, which is why settings can reset. (source: docs/updates.mdx)

question: Does niri expose every Hyprland visual feature?

must_not_mention: all Hyprland plugins work on niri
expect.ideal: No. Ryoku Settings shows only capabilities the active compositor can honor: Hyprland's compositor plugins and its Animations/performance pages are not offered as working niri controls. Core Ryoku shortcuts remain shared, while compositor-owned options stay on that compositor's page. (source: ryoku/rashin/skills/ryoku/gui.md)

question: Where do I install extra applications?

expect.ideal: Open Ryostore for curated bundles, or use Browse RyoStore from Ryoku Settings > Add-ons. Individual repository packages can also be installed through the launcher's `>install` provider, the edition's package manager, or Flatpak; Ryoku does not require KDE Discover. (source: docs/faq.mdx)

question: Where can I lengthen the screen timeout?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Graphics & Power and adjust the Idle timings for AC and battery. Dim, lock, display-off, and suspend are separate stages; for a temporary keep-awake session, use Caffeine in Quick Settings. (source: docs/hardware.mdx)

question: My chosen wallpaper is missing after the next login. What should I check?

expect.ideal: Open Ryogami settings and make sure Restore wallpaper on startup is enabled. Start with `ryoku doctor --check`; if it reports the Ryogami service or a retired wallpaper daemon covering it, apply the offered Doctor repair and reopen Super+W. (source: stable Ryogami settings and docs/ryogami.md)

question: How do I keep my monitor scale after unplugging and reconnecting it?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Displays, choose the output, set Scale, and use Apply. Ryoku keeps the per-machine layout for login and reconnect; generated monitor files are not the place for ordinary edits. (source: stable GUI map and docs/cli.md)

question: Is direct desktop widget editing available in the stable release?

expect.ideal: Yes. Right-click bare wallpaper, choose Edit desktop, then open Widgets in the Stage Editor. Add or select a widget, drag and resize its frame, and open its Settings; placement is kept per display. (source: docs/stage.md)

question: Where do I adjust the dock while seeing and clicking it in the desktop preview?

expect.ideal: Right-click bare wallpaper, choose Edit desktop, then open Dock. The Stage Editor is the dock's settings surface, and the dock stays visible and clickable inside the desktop preview while you change design, placement, behavior, and pins. (source: docs/stage.md and docs/ui-ux.md)

question: Does reduced motion turn off the default lock screen windup?

must_not_mention: Reduce motion disables the lockscreen windup
expect.ideal: No. Choose and preview the lockscreen design in Ryoku Settings > Lockscreen. Clockwork/Orbital's windup belongs to that qylock theme, not compositor motion or the shell's Reduce motion setting; choose a calmer design rather than editing managed theme files. (source: ryoku/lockscreen/README.md and the Clockwork/Orbital theme)

question: Where do I change the app that Super+E uses for folders?

must_mention_any: Ryoku Settings > Keybinds > Apps > App shortcuts
expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Keybinds > Apps > App shortcuts, find File manager, and choose an installed command such as Dolphin, Thunar, Nemo, or Nautilus. Super+E and Ryoku's file-manager role update immediately; this does not itself replace the inode/directory handler. (source: stable GUI map)

question: What is the normal stable-v1 path for pairing a Bluetooth headset?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > Connections > Connections > Bluetooth, turn the adapter on, press Scan, and select the headset to pair, trust, and connect it. Use Doctor and bluetoothctl logs only if that GUI flow reports unavailable, blocked, or repeatedly fails. (source: stable GUI map)

question: A window makes the wallpaper blurry and dark. Can I turn that effect off without changing GPUs?

expect.ideal: Open Ryoku Settings > General > Appearance and turn off Blur and dim behind windows. Its strength is separate from window shadows, inactive-window dimming, modal dimming, and the Graphics mode GPU selector. (source: stable GUI map and ryoku/hub/quickshell/schema/GlobalPage.js)
